name: Unidentified excursion liner
description: An excursion liner was owned by the Chiss Ascendancy's Boadil family, one of the Ascendancy's Nine Ruling Families, and captained by a member of the Ruling Ufsa family. The liner had a compact cylindrical shape, with two wide D-shaped wings on either side, housing expensive passenger suites. On one of the liner's voyages prior to 19 BBY, the captain took the vessel too close to a gas giant, and the liner was caught in its gravity well with 8,000 passengers aboard.
